title: Simulating Identity, Propagating Bias: Abstraction and Stereotypes in LLM-Generated Text

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate short texts linking nationality or place of origin categories with stereotypical, negated, or random attributes (under different persona conditions), and analyzing the linguistic abstraction of the outputs using concreteness, specificity, and negation metrics based on the Linguistic Expectancy Bias (LEB) framework.
